decisions.reason: As a recent line extension with only modest website prominence, it likely remains a low-cost option to keep testing in 2024, though the weaker visibility raises the chance of discontinuation if uptake disappoints.

Its own product page suggests stronger commercial backing, and for a German food producer the cost of keeping a new organic snack variant on the market for another year is likely low relative to the value of learning about demand.
The dedicated page indicates active support and the sharing-snack format still has unresolved market potential, so real-options logic favors keeping it unless 2024 sales quickly reveal weak value.
